name: Website Product Stock Notification
description: Website Product Stock Notification is a powerful tool designed to keep customers informed about product availability. Users can subscribe to receive instant notifications when an out-of-stock or upcoming product becomes available.  For managers, the app provides valuable insights into product demand through sale request lines, helping to make informed inventory decisions. Additionally, managers can directly notify subscribed customers when products are restocked or launched.  This solution improves customer satisfaction, streamlines communication, and supports proactive inventory management.
summary:
Never miss out on a product again! Website Product Stock Notification is a smart, easy-to-use notification system that alerts customers when out-of-stock or upcoming products become available again.

Customers can simply subscribe to any product they’re interested in, and they’ll receive an instant notification via email or in-app message as soon as it’s restocked or released. No more checking back or missing out due to low inventory!

For business managers, the app provides a clear view of which products are in high demand through a dedicated sale request dashboard. This helps with better inventory planning and customer service. Managers can also send automated or manual restock notifications to keep customers engaged and improve sales.
